data.title: 阿蕾克希亚 · 王宫夜宴露台的冷艳独酌
data.description: 王都主堡辉煌的宴会露台外，繁星与王都万家灯火连成一片。阿蕾克希亚身着纯白抹胸轻礼裙独自倚栏，手摇红酒杯冷淡俯瞰人间。
data.location: ornate palace marble balcony overlooking glowing nocturnal fantasy metropolis
data.action: leaning back against marble balustrade holding a stem wineglass with ruby wine, head tilted slightly, cynical yet proud gaze into distance
data.lighting: 室内溢出暖金光与清冷星夜月华
data.promptProse: Princess Alexia in an elegant white corset dress leans against a palace balcony balustrade holding red wine, glancing out coolly over the glowing capital.
data.animaCaption: Distant city lights shimmer below as she raises her wineglass with a detached smirk.
